title: The hero's journey
examples: Does every hero have to fight a monster?
Can a story be about a journey without a big battle?
Is the mentor always a wise old person?

explain.say: The hero's journey begins when the hero receives a call to adventure.

items: The hero is asked to leave home.

draw.text: Call to Adventure: The initial call

explain.say: Next, the hero often meets a mentor who gives them important advice.
The journey includes trials, which are challenges the hero must overcome.
After the challenges, the hero must complete the return to their ordinary world.
Think about a story like Harry Potter leaving school for the final challenge.
A common mistake is thinking the mentor always gives all the answers.

items: The mentor guides, but the hero acts.
The hero must use the advice themselves.

faq.q: Does the hero have to go to a magical place?
faq.a: No, the journey can happen anywhere, even in a normal town. It is about the internal change.
asks: Does the location matter for the journey?

faq.q: What if the hero fails all the trials?
faq.a: Failure is often a necessary part of learning. It shows what the hero still needs to learn.
asks: Is failing part of the process?
Can the journey end in failure?

faq.q: Is the mentor always a person?
faq.a: A mentor can be an object, a piece of knowledge, or even an animal. It is something that teaches.
asks: Can an object be a mentor?
Does the guide have to be alive?

faq.q: What is the main purpose of the return?
faq.a: The return shows that the hero has changed and brought something valuable back to their community.
asks: Why does the hero come back?
What does the return give the community?

faq.q: Is the call to adventure always dramatic?
faq.a: It can be subtle, like a small mystery or a quiet realization. It starts the change slowly.

facts: The hero's journey is a common pattern in stories.
It involves a departure from the known world.
Mentors provide necessary skills or knowledge.
The return often brings a boon or treasure.

quiz.say: A character suddenly realizes they must leave their comfortable life to solve a great problem. This is the:
quiz.why: This marks the beginning of the hero's necessary departure from the ordinary world.

wrong.1: Trials happen after the hero has already left home and faced initial obstacles.
wrong.2: The return happens at the very end, after all the fighting is done.
wrong.3: The mentor gives help, but the realization of the journey is the call itself.

quiz.say: A young wizard receives training from an old, powerful figure who teaches him magic.
quiz.why: The mentor provides the wisdom and skills needed for the hero to face bigger challenges.

wrong.0: The return is the journey back home, not the learning phase.
wrong.2: The trials are the tests, not the person who teaches you for them.
wrong.3: The call is the invitation; the mentor is the guide who accepts the invitation.

quiz.say: After defeating the villain, the hero travels back to their village, bringing a magical object that heals the land.
quiz.why: The return completes the cycle by showing the benefit of the adventure to the home community.

wrong.1: The call just starts the journey; it does not involve coming back with gifts.
wrong.2: The mentor is the helper; they do not complete the cycle by returning.
wrong.3: Trials are the difficulties faced on the way out, not the final coming back.
